title: Pose, Expression, View & Frame Selector
objective: Select governed pose, expression, view and animation-frame variants for an existing SAA-05 actor when its referenced appearance/resource owners expose them, while preserving explicit unsupported or unavailable states and never fabricating variant coverage or mutating Character/CAPP/PPIA/PAPT/PCA/ARI truth.
acceptance: Variant selection operates on an existing SAA-05 actor reference and preserves stable actor, owner and renderer-neutral appearance-projection identity.
Pose, expression, view and animation-frame choices reference governed owner-supplied variant identities rather than copying or inventing canonical appearance state.
Supported variant dimensions and values are explicit, typed and deterministically ordered.
Unsupported, missing, unavailable, stale or rights-blocked variants fail closed with explicit state instead of silently substituting a default.
Selecting a variant produces presentation-only actor state consumable by SAA-03 composition without mutating Character/NPC/Creature, CAPP/PPIA, PAPT/PCA, ARI or Scene truth.
Nonhuman and topology-specific actors never receive silent humanoid pose/expression/view fallback.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can inspect and select every blocking variant choice without requiring drag gestures.
Provider-off local operation is supported for locally available governed variants; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-07 maps/tilesets/Scene background projection and all later SAA/export/share/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-05.1 actor projection identity and all SAA-01..04 predecessor contracts remain sealed.
Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form owner domains retain canonical identity, anatomy, mechanics and live state.
CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority; PAPT/PCA retain production/rig primitives; ARI retains resource identity/provenance/rights authority.
SAA-06 selects only owner-exposed presentation variants; it may not synthesize unsupported coverage or silently mutate actor/appearance truth.
Maps, tilesets and Scene background projection begin with SAA-07.
No export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
next_action: SAA-06 is completed_verified. SAA-07 — Maps, Tilesets & Scene Background Projection — is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
